scope: Additional pinned Q4 2023 training data; same already explored Feb2024 labels, no independent holdout
primary_copier_target: 30-day net terminal wealth / initial cash under frozen single-copier standard
auxiliary_target: Equal-weight wallet-condition first BUY eventual binary payoff minus leader fill price per share; no fees or execution inferred
train_label_barrier: resolved_at + 24h strictly before split; sensitivity 0h and168h; retrospective event timestamp conditional availability proxy only
group_barrier: Purge all raw Oct-Jan conditions globally from Febtest; same rules/models/thresholds
identity: lowercase taker only, no maker inversion
first_buy_rule: Earliest BUY second before any price/label validity filter; exclude group unless exactly one raw row at that second

models.mean_edge: mean of per-condition label-minus-price training edges
models.shrinkage_edge: sum edges / (n + 5), five fixed zero-edge pseudo-observations; hypothesis parameter, not tuned
models.lcb_edge: mean - 1.645 * sample_sd / sqrt(n); descriptive normal-approximation ranking penalty, not calibrated financial confidence bound
models.random_top_k: uniform subset of same K eligible addresses; exact expected result equals unranked mean
models.win_rate: mean eventual binary outcome among training condition purchases; deliberately price-blind comparator

selection: Top ceil(eligible addresses / 4), ties by SHA256 wallet, no positive-score filtering
evaluation: Rank ALL traineligible addresses before looking at future membership; fixed topK, unavailable test wallets remain missing; conditional observed means with model-specific coverage, not equal cohort or missing=0
uncertainty: Shared test-condition cluster Poisson bootstrap with selection fixed from training; descriptive interval, no independence assertion
sensitivity: filter first observation price to [0.1,0.9] AFTER grouping
overlap allowed as explicitly non-independent sensitivity
ce_model: not identifiable: no auditable copier wealth paths; omit rather than manufacture positive wealth transform
winner_rule: No confirmatory winner on already explored data. Report descriptive proxy ordering and coverage; research candidate may be chosen by simpler estimation and uncertainty handling only, with superiority unverified
cluster_interval: Descriptive condition-Poisson-weighted interval of conditional available-wallet difference vs alltraineligible available wallets; different future retention remains a limitation
